> #### 1) Permissions Required [doc-0038]

Documented guidance:
- Verify that your user account has the 'Project Control' role, as this permission is required to access the rerun functionality. [doc-0038]
- Ensure the current snapshot is the latest eligible snapshot for the pipeline, as the button is disabled if an older snapshot is selected. [doc-0038]
- Confirm that the build is not currently in progress, as the control is disabled while the build is running. [doc-0038]
- Check that the code-quality step has a quality status of 'DIRTY', because only steps with this status are eligible for rerun. [doc-0038]
- Verify that the component is of type 'UIBuildService Application' or 'UIBuildService Web Component' and the step is 'Codescan', as these are the only currently supported types. [doc-0038]
- Ensure that another rerun submission is not already in progress, as this condition disables the button. [doc-0038]

Once you have **submitted** the component and step for rerun, it will take some time for the component/step to be transitioned to the "In progress" state. Reload the page after 3-5 mins, to find the latest state of component/step. 

#### Build Results page

Kindly make a note of the following - 

* The selected scans will be rerun on the **same snapshot**, and **no new snapshot** will be created after rerun submission.
* There will be **no impact** to other steps of the same component, or to any other components that were part of the original snapshot build.
* The **Deploy/Test** stages will remain the same as in the original snapshot, and there will be **no impact** to them.

#### Pipeline Runs page

How to Identify Whether a Scan Was Rerun
----------------------------------------

To differentiate between a rerun scan and a non-rerun scan:

* If a scan is rerun for a given **component** and **snapshot**, an **“R”** icon will appear next to the **step name**.
* When you hover over the step, the tooltip will display the **step name** along with the label **“(Rerun)”**.

User Interface
--------------

### Overview

For each completed pipeline a new action will be available to "Rerun Scans":

### Rerun Scans Action Button Restrictions

#### 1) Permissions Required

* + **Project Control** role

#### 2) Button Visibility (When the Button Is Rendered)

The **Rerun Scans** button is rendered **only if**:

* + The snapshot is the **latest** eligible snapshot of the pipeline
	+ At least one component is of **UIBuildService type**

#### 3) Button Disablement (When the Button Is Disabled)

The button is disabled if **any** of the following are true:

* + Build is in progress
	+ Current snapshot is not the latest eligible snapshot
	+ No eligible components/steps are available for rerun
	+ User lacks permission
	+ A rerun submission is already in progress

### Rerun Scans Dialog Restrictions

retrieved_sources.title: Rerun scans support
retrieved_sources.text:
After clicking on the "Rerun Scans" button from the Actions bar, the following dialog will appear - 

#### 1) Components shown in the popup

Shown only:

* Components that have **eligible rerun steps**
	+ **Currently supported:** UIBuildService Application / Web Component (UIBuildService)

#### 2) Eligible Rerun steps (per Component)

A step is eligible for rerun only if **all** conditions are met:  
 

* The step is **enabled for the component type.**
	+ **Currently supported:** Codescan step
* Step quality is **DIRTY**

#### 3) Submit button disabled condition

The **Submit** button in the popup is disabled when:

* **Reason validation fails**
	+ Required length: **10–60 characters**

#### 4) Submit validation failure conditions

Submission fails validation when:

* No components are selected, or
* No steps are selected

**Central JIRAissuekey,summary,issuetype,created,updated,duedate,assignee,reporter,priority,status,customfield_15507,resolutionkey,summary,type,created,updated,due,assignee,reporter,priority,status,Status,resolutionadf9d0b9-328f-38b2-a954-2899436ad300CloudNativeCICD-13902**

1. Developers review **CodeScan violations**.
2. After review, developers often submit **exemption requests** to the **TA team**.
3. Once the TA team processes the exemptions, developers currently must:  
a) Kick off an **ad hoc build** with **no code changes**  
b) Generate a **new publish version**  
c) Create an **WorkspaceCLI transaction** and update the **JSON file** with the new version.

This process is inefficient because it requires a full build cycle even when no code changes are involved. 

Rerun scans will help avoid steps **(a), (b), and (c)** by enabling developers to **rerun CodeScan for VB components** directly.

Requirements
------------

Central JIRAissuekey,summary,issuetype,created,updated,duedate,assignee,reporter,priority,status,customfield_15507,resolutionkey,summary,type,created,updated,due,assignee,reporter,priority,status,Status,resolutionadf9d0b9-328f-38b2-a954-2899436ad300CloudNativeCICD-17305

**Rerun Scans** will enable the team to rerun specific scans for selected components without triggering an additional adhoc build.

* In the **initial release**, rerun scans will be supported for:
	+ **UIBuildService Application and UIBuildService Web component**
		- **CodeScan step**
* In **upcoming releases**, this functionality will be extended to additional scans and components.

High level support
------------------

The initial need to support rerun scans for VB components is driven by the current workflow for **CloudNative/UIBuildService builds.**
